question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"overburdened."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Overburdened"** means to be weighed down with too much work or responsibility. (बहुत अधिक काम या जिम्मेदारी के बोझ तले दब जाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The team was **overburdened**__ with deadlines and had to work overtime to complete the project.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The word is formed by adding the prefix "over-" (meaning too much) to the verb "burden".
 
• The correct answer is option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

The world is becoming increasingly (1) __urbanised__. Since 2007, more than half of the world's population has been living in cities, and that share is (2) __projected__ to rise to 60 percent by 2030. Cities and metropolitan areas are powerhouses of economic growth- (3)__ contributing__ about 60 percent of global GDP. However, they also account for about 70 percent of global carbon emissions and over 60 percent of (4) __resource__ use. Rapid urbanisation is resulting in a growing number of slum dwellers, inadequate and (5) __**overburdened**__ infrastructure and services, worsening air pollution, and unplanned urban sprawl. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Destructed"** means destroyed or ruined. (नष्ट या बरबाद)
 
• **"Redundant"** means unnecessary or superfluous. ((कर्मचारी) गै़र-ज़रूरी और इसलिए बेकार, फ़ालतू, अतिरिक्त)
 
• **"Necessary"** means required or essential. ((प्रयोजन विशेष या कारण विशेष से) आवश्‍यक, ज़रूरी)
